mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals strong demand, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth reverses or remains flat while returns are positive, or FEDFUNDS rise significantly offsetting the GDP signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) crosses above 5.0%, it signals weakening labor market conditions, prompting central banks to tighten policy, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 5.0% in the next month
failure_condition: UNRATE stays above 5.0% but returns remain positive, or other factors dominate the return movement.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) and a decline in unemployment (UNRATE) during a tightening cycle signals monetary policy tightening, which reduces discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% and UNRATE falls below 5.0% in the next month
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rise but UNRATE also rises, leading to negative returns despite the interaction.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, simultaneous high GDP growth (GDPC1) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal overheating, prompting investors to anticipate a peak and pullback, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above 12,000 and CPIAUCSL crosses above 230 in the same quarter
failure_condition: GDPC1 remains below 12,000 or CPIAUCSL stays below 230 in the current quarter, yet returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, which compresses discount rates on equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 4.0% in the next quarter
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS stay below 4.0% yet returns are negative, or other factors dominate the return movement.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) coupled with rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust demand across sectors, lowering discount rates and driving up equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above 15,000 and INDPRO crosses above 100 in the same quarter
failure_condition: INDPRO remains below 100 or GDPC1 doesn't rise, yet returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle contraction regime, high unemployment (UNRATE) and falling GDP (GDPC1) signal weakening demand and economic slowdown, prompting investors to anticipate prolonged stagnation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 6.0% and GDPC1 falls below 14,000 in the same quarter
failure_condition: GDPC1 remains above 14,000 or UNRATE doesn't rise, yet returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: During a recessionary regime, high unemployment (UNRATE) and falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) signal weak labor market conditions and accommodative monetary policy, which may initially boost risk assets but ultimately lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 7.0% and FEDFUNDS falls below 0.05 in the same month
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remain above 0.05 or UNRATE doesn't rise, yet returns are negative.
